name: cannibal.r_caol_first_smoke_011_r027_roof_combined_20260928
description: Fresh R027 ordinary-view roof brazier light-plus-smoke arm from byte-exact clean prepared save; maintain fire and follow natural camp response.

steps.label: load_byte_exact_clean_pre_signal_roof_start
steps.expected_visible_fact: Effective userdir must load the fresh 45-file roof-start copy matching build_logs/first-smoke-020/clean-roof-combined-copy-manifest.json; saved baseline turn5216234, player [3156,3449,0], roof brazier [3156,3447,1]. Verify same-run World, current turn, Safe Off, both clairvoyance mutations absent, no pending input, fire unlit, no signal/contact/knowledge/outing. Preserve prepared site geometry; do not relight indoor source.

steps.label: preserve_exact_prepared_roof_and_site_geometry
steps.expected_visible_fact: No fixture transform or camp movement. The exact saved map/profile is used; this run tests the ordinary roof source under R027.

steps.label: r027_ordinary_roof_fire_combined_signal_to_camp_outcome
steps.objective: Use the previously audited ordinary in-world ladder route only: verify player position and terrain, walk to the ladder, invoke native level_up, verify resulting supported z1 tile, then reach the prepared roof brazier at [3156,3447,1]. Check current weather, inspect fire/fuel and actual fire/smoke fields; ignite normally with supplied lighter only if unlit. Keep clear of the fire. At meaningful intervals collect actual fd_fire and per-tile fd_smoke at roof source, adjacent roof squares and z2 above; record weather, time, independent live_smoke/live_light packet source IDs/intensities/caps, and exact staffed camp signal read (source OMT, channel, cap, distance, LOS, rejection/admission and lead source sample). Do not stop at early cap6/fire-only or infer smoke from a synthetic live_smoke channel. Maintain burning fire and use useful safe waits; no repeated unchanged waits after stable contradiction. If a smoke lead/roster is admitted, follow same-ID scout, watch, physical return/report, and natural night raid through actual actor action/damage/outcome. Track raiders, defenders and avatar from metadata. Save with world.quicksave alone at meaningful boundaries and verify saved turn. No north-step preamble.
proof_targets: 45/45 byte-exact clean roof-start copy, effective profile, source/executable/session binding and current mutable World/Safe/mutation state
ordinary native ladder travel and supported z1 position; actual normal lighter ignition or verified already-burning fire at roof brazier
actual weather and direct saved/live fd_fire/fd_smoke values at roof source, adjacent squares and z2 plume over time
distinct smoke and light channel packets tied to physical source/tile/intensity and actual channel-specific cap
staffed camp reads with exact distance, vertical LOS, terrain costs, reason and lead/source sample; distinguish emission from admission
same-ID scout/watch/return/report and any actual raid/combat only after native admission
native quicksave confirmed turns/payload hashes, meaningful actor health/action/outcome, simulation timings and cleanup
invariants: Fresh disposable copy only; owner/reference source unchanged and prior smoke-contact arm remains separate
Ordinary view; no clairvoyance, cloak, invulnerability, teleport, debug signal/fire/smoke/light/dispatch/contact/report injection or debug kills
No camp/site/map/roster/knowledge/outing change; no silent geometry adjustment
Use only advertised native movement, ladder, lighter, wait, look, inspect and quicksave controls; verify each transition before next action
Roof fire remains lit during observation unless a concrete safety blocker requires stopping
A live_smoke marker is not fd_smoke; record each field tile and packet independently
Measure early cap and continue through relevant physical field/weather/time changes and staffed scans; do not declare failure from first cap alone
A smoke-only admission does not prove combined light+smoke admission; keep channels distinct
Quicksave action alone without movement; verify actual saved turn

evidence_contract.claim: From a fresh byte-exact clean pre-signal save on R027, normal ladder travel and ordinary ignition of prepared roof brazier yield measurable real light and smoke channels and determine whether eligible cannibal observers admit either signal; if admitted, follow same-ID natural response/outcome.
evidence_contract.failure_rule: Do not infer physical fd_smoke from live_smoke or emission from admission. Preserve first source/run-bound rejection only after actual field, weather, range and LOS evidence; continue if the measured state is evolving.
